description: Agent Tax Records: submit tax payment records with the filed returns whose amounts due they answer to: each filed return with its id, reference, form, tax period, due date, the amount it states as due and its currency; each tax payment with its id, reference, the filed return it pays, the day paid, the amount, the confirmation number and its currency. The signed report gives the filed returns and the tax payments, the payments against each filed return added against its amount due, each payment date against the due date of the filed return it pays, each payment against the filed return beneath it, and each liability read for a second payment, and counts them, and names a divergent tax payment record: a filed return paid short of its amount due, nothing paid included, a tax payment dated after its due date, a tax payment with no filed return beneath it, and the same liability paid twice, by two payments each at the amount due or one confirmation number on two payments; then a filed return paid above its amount due and a payment currency unlike its filed return’s, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No filed returns, no tax payments, a filed return with no amount due, a payment with no amount, or no due date beside a payment leaves those points unverified. Payments match their filed return by its reference read by letters and digits, the payments against one filed return add together, amounts compare to the cent and dates by the day. This reads whether each tax payment answers to the filed return beneath it, in full and on time. Verdict tax_payment_divergent, tax_payment_partial, tax_payment_unverified or tax_payment_consistent. POST /api/tax-payment-check. Reads the tax records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it gives no tax advice, prepares or files nothing and decides nothing about anyone’s tax liability, which stay with the taxpayer and their tax professional, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Tax Records reads tax records: a filed return, tax payment records, sales tax records, withholding records, information returns, estimated payment records, deduction claims and tax authority notices, each against the books, schedules and deadline, the amounts the filed returns state as due, the stated rate and the sales tax remittances, the payroll record and the withholding remittances, the payment records, the periods and amounts the stated method sets, the support records, or the filed returns and responses it answers to. The family’s ground is the tax record set itself; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the books the filings are drawn from, and this family reads the filings, payments and notices after they exist. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-tax-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-tax-records/.

filings.description: Each filed return with the amount it states as due.

amount_due.description: The amount the filing states as due.

due_on.description: The day the payment is due.

period.description: The tax period, such as 2025, 2026-Q1 or 2026-03.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
